title: Binary Tree Pruning
summary: Given a binary tree's root, retain only those subtrees containing at least one 1, removing all others.
statement: Given a binary tree's root, retain only those subtrees containing at least one 1, removing all others.
constraints: Every node value is zero or one.
Remove every subtree that contains no value one.
Return the remaining root, or None if the entire tree is removed.

reference_solution:
def prune_zero_subtrees(root):
    if root is None:return None
    root.left=prune_zero_subtrees(root.left);root.right=prune_zero_subtrees(root.right)
    if root.val==0 and root.left is None and root.right is None:return None
    return root
